## Instructions

1. Soak the beans overnight.
2. Drain, cover with fresh water and boil until the skins split when you blow on them.
3. Put onion in the bean pot, then beans and salt pork.
4. Mix molasses, brown sugar and mustard with some cooking water; pour over.
5. Cover with water and bake at 275°F about 6 hours, adding water as needed.

## Notes

Saturday night supper with brown bread.
